item.title: Marathon's frustrating lack of duo lobbies has just been tacked onto Bungie's to-do list
item.description: Despite already having a fairly long list of Marathon feedback to tackle, Bungie has bolted on two more Server Slam grumbles.

item.title: Marvel Rivals events - all current and upcoming events
item.description: We have all the information on current and upcoming Marvel Rivals events so you never miss out on competing for those cosmic rewards.

item.title: PCs under $500 to "disappear by 2028." Apparently water's wet, too.
item.description: Rising memory and SSD costs will also make "low-margin entry-level laptops nonviable" as AI chip consumption set to continue without a dip.

item.title: Sure, League of Legends' Shyvana rework is finally here, but did Riot just talk about Twisted Treeline?
item.description: Yes, Shyvana's rework looks great, but at the end of its latest developer diary, Riot has teased the return of a League of Legends favorite.

item.title: Dead by Daylight's creative director would "love to" do more Chapter remakes after All-Kill Comeback
item.description: DBD’s Dave Richard teases to us that All-Kill Comeback could spark more Chapter remakes as there are “so many stories left to be told.”

item.title: World of Warcraft has stagnated for years. Midnight changes that.
item.description: I’ve been dreaming of a World of Warcraft 2 for years, but with new expansion Midnight, Blizzard has successfully reinvented its MMO.

item.title: Ark modder issues statement after being called "lazy" and "uncreative" for reusing assets from an abandoned game
item.description: A famous modder of open-world sandbox RPG Ark Survival Ascended claims that being a level designer is why an update borrows from Atlas.

item.title: The next Cities Skylines 2 creator pack is bad news for work from home citizens, but good news for architecture aficionados
item.description: Two new Cities Skylines 2 community packs are set to drop alongside the city building game's second update from its new development team.

item.title: Moon Studios' CEO thinks No Rest for the Wicked could be a "forever game" with the foundations of one that "could rival Hades"
item.description: Though there are no plans to drop the action-RPG, the combat of No Rest for the Wicked could lead to Moon Studios taking on the survival genre.

item.title: After removing its worst feature, Runescape just upended its entire combat system after only three months of player testing
item.description: Not long after giving microtransactions the boot, sweeping combat changes to Runescape just gave the MMORPG another big refresh for 2026.
